doc: Boss script for Monster Gaspard (kind 511; its effects are named M Gil), fought on a circular arena of radius 600 with eight magma pools. It alternates a surface phase (walks to the ring, slams Vanguard shockwaves, fires flame shots) with a magma phase (dives into the nearest pool, fires flame volleys and surfaces to rest), adding flame shots below 50% and 20% life. Its skin heats and cools with the phase, and event 570 plays on its death.
